name: Power Bicycle
description: An e-bike: a bicycle with pedals, handlebars, no more than three wheels and electric motors totalling 500 W or less that stop assisting at 32 km/h, the power-assisted bicycle of the federal Motor Vehicle Safety Regulations.

restrictions.rule: Handlebars, pedals, no more than three wheels, and can be propelled by muscular power
restrictions.citation: Use of Highway and Rules of the Road Regulation, Alta. Reg. 304/2002, s. 1(1)(o); Motor Vehicle Safety Regulations, C.R.C., c. 1038, s. 2(1), before SOR/2020-22

restrictions.rule: Electric motors with a total continuous power output of 500 W or less that can't assist past 32 km/h on level ground; assistance stops when pedalling stops or, with a throttle, when the brakes are applied
restrictions.citation: Use of Highway and Rules of the Road Regulation, Alta. Reg. 304/2002, s. 1(1)(o); Motor Vehicle Safety Regulations, C.R.C., c. 1038, s. 2(1), before SOR/2020-22

restrictions.rule: The federal definition Alberta's points to was repealed by SOR/2020-22, but the province still applies its 500 W and 32 km/h limits
Riders must be 12 or older, and riders under 18 must carry a parent's or guardian's consent unless they hold an operator's licence
restrictions.citation: Operator Licensing and Vehicle Control Regulation, Alta. Reg. 320/2002, s. 9

restrictions.rule: Riders under 16 may not carry passengers
restrictions.citation: Use of Highway and Rules of the Road Regulation, Alta. Reg. 304/2002, s. 76

restrictions.rule: Rider and passenger must wear a helmet meeting a motorcycle helmet standard
restrictions.citation: Vehicle Equipment Regulation, Alta. Reg. 122/2009, ss. 107 and 108

restrictions.rule: The province's cycling guidance says a bicycle helmet is also accepted
Needs a headlamp, tail lamp, brake lamp, side and pedal reflectors, a left side mirror, a horn or bell and a brake on each wheel, with its lamps lit whenever it's on a highway
restrictions.citation: Vehicle Equipment Regulation, Alta. Reg. 122/2009, ss. 10, 13, 18, 50, 54, 60 and 110; Use of Highway and Rules of the Road Regulation, Alta. Reg. 304/2002, s. 55(2)

restrictions.rule: Ridden as near as practicable to the right edge of the roadway, and on the paved shoulder where there is one
restrictions.citation: Use of Highway and Rules of the Road Regulation, Alta. Reg. 304/2002, s. 77

restrictions.rule: Not ridden on a sidewalk or boulevard unless a municipal bylaw allows it
restrictions.citation: Use of Highway and Rules of the Road Regulation, Alta. Reg. 304/2002, s. 13

restrictions.rule: Not a motor vehicle: no operator's licence, registration or insurance
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.A. 2000, c. T-6, s. 1(1)(x)

restrictions.rule: One past these limits is a moped or motorcycle that must be licensed, registered and insured
